_doc: Wire slots part features own, pinned at today's positions (protocol 16; the status row's tow moved from 8 to 6 when the heat fields left it, rework 2026-11 firing models; the weaponry statuses appended in protocol 19, shot behaviours). APPEND-ONLY: never move or remove an entry; a new slot is a wire change (npm run wire:bump). Not part of the wire hash. pilotExtra: in order, after the pilot row's charge groups (strafer.ts pilotExtras). status: index in the status row other pilots get (net/SnapshotBuilder.ts). keyframe: index in a keyframe row (network/replication.ts packKeyframe). ctl: the replica control bit (replica.ts CTL). Checked by features/registry.test.ts.
